description: This file defines the FakeEmailService class, which implements the EmailService interface. It provides methods to simulate sending emails by logging and printing email details to the console, and is intended for use in local, development, or testing environments.

classes.name: FakeEmailService
classes.description: A mock implementation of EmailService for sending fake emails during local, dev, or test environments, mainly for logging and testing purposes.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Simulates sending a simple email message by logging and printing message details to the console.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Simulates sending an email using a Thymeleaf template, logging the action and printing email details.
